race.description: Duttons Easy To Do Business With! Hcp (C2)
race.comment: PURFECT LINE (3) travelled worse than midfield then got going late to grab second over 1050m at Morphettville last time out when second-up from a spell. Doesn't boast the best strike rate but should be about the mark again over the longer trip. BRIMARVI ROSEMARIE (10) gets a long way back in her races and as a result she has just the two wins from 23. Should run well today over a longer journey. The lightly raced GOLDEN CLOUD (9) will be cherry-ripe at the third run back and has to be included in the main chances, while OBUCCI (5) has to be included with Calllow sticking aboard.
